rule: One scalar drives light: WeatherManager.SetSunlightScale picks one weather branch (rain, storm, snow, overcast, else winter base, else 1.0) and multiplies shadow by exp(-50 x fog density); SunlightManager multiplies its curve by that scale and PlayerAmbientLight lerps night-to-noon ambient by the same value. Weather is re-rolled per climate group from WeatherTable.json (cumulative 0-100 roll) when the in-game date changes; the 30-second poll is commented out. Clock: 12 game seconds per real second; day 06:00-18:00; city lights 17:00-08:00; season from month (Dec-Feb winter). Sky: 64 frames, second half mirrors the first. Ambient one-shots on a random 4-35 s timer (code default), chosen by weather and time preset.
keep: One sun/ambient scalar drives sun pitch, sun intensity, shadow strength and ambient colour.
Weather odds as a climate x season table in data, not in code.
Climate-group roll shared by every zone of that climate, once per in-game day.
Season from the month, with the season-from-month rule written in one place.
Mirrored sky frames to halve the art.
Season and rain texture offsets as archive index additions.
Ambient one-shot timer by preset (rain, storm, day, night).
change: Instant weather change (TODO at WeatherManager.cs line 28): lerp fog density and sun scale over about 4 seconds.
Client-side clock (WorldTime.cs line 67): replace with a server epoch and a pure time function on the client.
Cloudy is not real (WeatherManager.cs line 449; Questing/Actions/Weather.cs lines 64-65 always false): give cloudy its own scale and make the quest check the same flag.
Overcast leaves the sky style alone (WeatherManager.cs 224-227 versus 161): check overcast night stars before copying.
Ambient seed from DateTime.Now.Millisecond (AmbientEffectsPlayer.cs line 79): seed from the zone and server tick.
Lightning path is disabled (PlayLightningEffect 0 at scene lines 522 and 1360; AmbientEffectsPlayer.cs line 21 says deprecated): write our own presentation-only flash if we want one.
Light curve wrap: pre and post infinity serialised as 2 (SunlightRig.prefab), and night times lie outside [0,1]. Clamp the time in our code and check the editor setting before reuse (not run).
Fog gate: heavy fog half-visibility about 14 units, so cap it so three attackers at fight distance stay readable at 375 wide.
look_test: On Dom's phone, a 375-wide preview with one enemy and one player silhouette on flat ground, a time slider from 06:00 to 18:00 and three toggles (clear, overcast at sun x0.65, heavy fog at density 0.05). Compare the donor sun-and-ambient scalar with the same scene at half the fog density. Dom judges whether a threat colour still reads at fight distance in fog and whether sun pitch alone tells the time in under one second. Publish as a style flag to /preview/ with no release rows and no lock. Target file: src/fight/weather-light.ts (proposed, not checked against the repo). Parity row 16.
